Không thể strict hit q17, q21, q27 (evidence 971/562/823 ký tự). Embed 32.3 s; query TB 110 ms; 0 USD. Ablation filter (4 câu, cùng index): 1/4 -> 1/4. Coherence 0.5/2; grounding 0.8/2 (nhãn nháp AI)
